rules.classification: KEEP scoped accepted casting; explicit local selections below
rules.text: Use the actual class-access row, earned repertoire/preparation, casting ability, normal PB, current components, costs, strain and exact beginning/ending hooks. Woven Threads and Creation are rank5/base10RP; Haze is rank6/base13RP. All are Action, V/S/F and Instantaneous, with no ongoing concentration. Ordinary casting commits its Action, actual payment, components, prospective concentration consequence where relevant, first-family history and Refrain before the real counter window. Countering, invalidation after legal commitment or hidden failure refunds nothing. A known illegal declaration commits nothing. No generic upcast, additional save, actor, material, repertoire, feature or free Action is supplied. A Wizard's automatic school bonuses and first prepared-family exemption retain actual scopes; first-family exemption does not erase explicit extra strain or Refrain. Actual all-source recovery/absorption protections retain their exact scopes; no resource-generating permission follows from a memory or material receipt.

rules.classification: KEEP ordinary Ready; NEW Woven temporal-selector detail only
rules.text: Ordinary Ready pays one actual casting transaction at preparation, including its one Counterspell window, and requires its real concentration slot through resolution. It expires at the next regular own START; a response at that deadline is too late. A perceived trigger completes first, then a legal release spends the real Reaction and selects actual targets/area under its fixed spell/mode and preparation choices. No second RP/component/history/counter transaction occurs. Woven fixes Erase/Replace, its complete <=60-word narrative or event-description, and FIXED or RELATIVE temporal selection at preparation; its actual creature is selected at release. FIXED timestamps remain fixed. RELATIVE offsets become fixed at legal release before hidden results. Haze's intrinsic window is always resolution-relative. Creation fixes composition, mass, reference value, intended shape/profile and studied credentials at preparation; supported placement is selected at release. Release cannot edit the recorded payload in response to a save, hidden ineligibility or a missed memory window. Losing the hold before resolution prevents the payload. These nonconcentration effects release their hold after instantaneous resolution. No copied-feat allowance, new interrupt or extra Reaction is imported. COPY-READY-ALLOWANCE-02 remains separately unchanged.

rules.classification: NEW two-spell episodic-history completion; inherits accepted Disrupt Memory distinctions
rules.text: All memory intervals use exact elapsed timestamps and half-open [start,end) boundaries. Prior experiences at the lower bound qualify; experiences at resolution time itself do not. Concurrent source applications retain actual authoritative sequence ordering without changing older event timestamps. Eligibility concerns personally experienced episodic event/facet IDs, not the date asserted by a story. No experience is manufactured during unconsciousness or an interval actually unobserved. A currently inaccessible real episode can receive another otherwise eligible edit; a present thought about yesterday is a new thought event, not authority to edit yesterday. Store true original experienced content privately and separately from accessible overlays, actual world events, external records, independent learned facts and gameplay resource/history ledgers. Successful later Haze/Woven edits dominate accessible family content only on their actual intersections; preserve earlier unrecovered layers and original DCs beneath them. Death/revival, loading, initiative transitions and ordinary rest do not wipe this provenance. Instantaneous completion leaves a lasting recollection change, not a live spell to dispel/suppress later. Actual antimagic can prevent its local manifestation at resolution. This grants no Charmed, hard-denial admission, compelled decision, automatic concentration ending, training deletion, formula grant, retroactive consent, resource refund or action reversal. A password learned solely in an edited event may be inaccessible, while older independently held knowledge survives. Creature type alone is not a mental immunity. Actual memory/mind defenses apply only within their own text. No private event IDs, unseen roster, DC, source identity or eligibility reason are exposed to a caster by success/failure.

rules.classification: NEW Woven/Haze-only evidence recovery, explicitly selected; not a global memory rule
rules.text:
After acquiring specific credible independent evidence, the recipient may undertake ten uninterrupted minutes (600 actual seconds) of active examination. It is not a free Action, short rest, ritual cast, new recovery pool or time-discounted research project. Select one continuous real interval <=60 seconds and a fixed method/evidence set before the attempt. Each evidence record carries immutable/versioned ID, independent provenance, actual lawful recipient access/comprehension, concrete corroborated/contradicted original event IDs and exact covered subinterval/facets. Coverage must be affirmatively authored from that evidence, not inferred from a contradiction elsewhere. The attempt's eligible portion is the union of covered personally experienced facets inside the selected interval. Gaps and unsupported events remain unaffected. A witness can supply credible independent evidence of a shared event; parroting the altered recipient, an unsupported assertion, a forged/ineligible record or repetition of the same item is not authenticated coverage. A mere named event, true private server log or casting suspicion is not player-accessible evidence. The private validator must not turn refusal, dice visibility or completion into a hidden-truth oracle; public presentation is limited to the recipient's genuine recovered own recollection and their ordinary evidence, with no source/DC/roster disclosure.
At completion revalidate actual reviewed evidence and qualifying portion; use the highest original application DC among all still-unrecovered Haze/Woven edits intersecting that portion, including layers masked by later edits. A weaker recast cannot lower an existing higher DC. Roll the recipient's actual WIS(Insight) task once, with real applicable proficiency and Core natural shifts. Success/Critical Success removes only the selected covered intersections from every relevant Haze/Woven restriction and reveals the true original wherever no independent source still blocks it. Neither degree grants bonus facts, older episodes, caster identity or compelled belief/truth. Failure/Critical Failure changes no memory and supplies no false certainty or extra injury. The same failed evidence/method/portion cannot be rerolled without materially new independently recorded evidence or a genuinely distinct usable method; mere relabelling/reordering is not novelty. An interrupted attempt gets no roll or recovery and must perform a fresh full600 seconds; no partial-time bank. Retain attempt start/end, interruption/failure fingerprint, roll, DC, covered event IDs, prior/edit intersections and idempotent settlement ID. A duplicate completion cannot roll or restore again.
No last-minute limit applies to recovery itself: the original edits were constrained at application, not erased from history by age. This rule removes only this named family. In particular, accepted Disrupt Memory's independent firsthand loss remains; evidence may teach new facts about it without restoring its erased firsthand experience. Another genuinely authorized memory-restoration effect uses its own complete source. In simultaneous/concurrent cases, no retry or restoration silently modifies a different source or post-start unexamined evidence. The selected interval/evidence cannot be enlarged after the result. An actually live separately authored Erase from Reality identity mask still controls access to the memory it masks after this family's restrictions are removed. This recovery does not end that mask, its untargetability or its own typed deadline. The accepted source's actual ending may later expose the surviving original; no new interaction permission is inferred from a similar name. Ordinary examination of an unhelpful record remains possible at its real time/opportunity cost. The absence of a private recovery DC is never a free player-facing authenticity or hidden-edit test, a refunded work order, or permission to disclose whether a particular event was truly changed.

rules.classification: NEW Creation-only physical-lot and exact local partition completion
rules.text:
Each successful Creation has one immutable root production ID and exact positive total mass, composition, creation timestamp, ordinary undamaged reference value and current/max structural state. Physical slices carry exact rational shares, source/sample/profile identity, previous custody, consumed/waste status and structural history. No silent second original lot, invented donor, soul identity, duplicated ingredient, cash or harvest stock is created. Before an actually lawful physical cut resolves, fix its parent leaf, geometrical cut plan, exact positive child/residue masses and unique immutable ordinal child IDs in neutral plan order. Their mass sum must equal that parent's actual available mass; record separately any source-authorized removed/consumed waste. Deal actual cutting damage at its actual source's stated order; a split itself grants no free cutting method, time, tool, proficiency or damage exemption.
For parent integer M>=C>=0 and exact positive weights w_i=m_i/sum(m), compute max floors floor(M*w_i); distribute remaining max points to descending fractional max remainder, ties by the predeclared child ID. Compute current floors floor(C*w_i); distribute remaining current points by descending current fractional remainder and the same tie rule, skipping children already at assigned maximum. Repeat the stable scan only while units remain; finite total capacity guarantees termination. Preserve exact total mass, reference value fractions, sum maximum M and sum current C. Current<=maximum for every leaf, including zero/zero. Rounding is spell-local structural accounting, not global currency or damage rounding.
Actual irreversible cut history controls. A later cut subdivides only its actual current parent leaf with that leaf's HP and lineage; it never rebalances detached siblings from root totals. The direct-three-way and staged-two-way allocations may differ and are both legitimate recorded histories. Renaming/reordering leaves after learning rounding results is not a new lawful partition. Combining, bundling, rejoining or Mending does not coalesce the leaves into a fresh apportionment parent or move structural points/damage between them. A cut of such an assembly acts on each participating original leaf separately and retains its share IDs. A later genuinely authorized full manufacturing/repair operation can have its own actual output/repair state, but must consume/account for the real inputs and costs; it is not a free merge/re-cut repair or duplicated value. At current0 retain real mass and fragments and no usable item benefits; zero-maximum fragments remain raw matter, not independently functioning equipment. Actual composition/shape and recipe eligibility decide whether that matter is usable, recoverable or waste. Consumed/burnt/missing mass cannot be restored by reclassification. No absorption, duplicate callback, transfer, ordinary rest or history reload regenerates material. Structural zero alone does not classify chemical composition, contamination, food safety or ingredient identity. Raw zero-maximum or Broken matter may still be genuine recipe stock or edible matter only where its actual physical condition and source-qualified process permit; it gains no functioning weapon/tool/armor durability merely by bundling.
